## Verdict

wrong

## Bearer

RaceListScreen — app-phone/src/main/java/com/mgilli/hyroxtracker/ui/racelist/RaceListScreen.kt

## Trigger

Rendering RaceListScreen with an empty `uiState.races` — observed inline in
the composable today, but not exposed as a standalone criterion for a test
to observe.

## Today

RaceListScreen.kt already renders an empty state: `RaceListEmptyState`
shows `PhoneStringResources.RaceList.emptyTitle`, `emptyBody` and
`emptyAction`, and the action's `onClick` calls `onAddResultClicked`, which
opens the paste screen. The switch is `uiState.races.isEmpty()`, checked
inline at line 40 of the composable — there is no standalone function
carrying that criterion. `RaceListUiState` carries only `races`. No test
exercises the screen's empty state: `RaceListViewModelTest` only asserts
`viewModel.uiState.value.races.isEmpty()` on the ViewModel, and no
`RaceListScreenTest.kt` file exists. The watch's equivalent,
`WatchHistoryScreen.kt`, exposes `internal fun isHistoryEmpty(uiState)`,
and `WatchHistoryScreenTest.kt` asserts it true on an empty list and false
on a non-empty one.

## Expected

RaceListScreen exposes its empty-state switch as a standalone, testable
criterion — the same shape as `WatchHistoryScreen.isHistoryEmpty` — used
in place of the inline `uiState.races.isEmpty()` check. A
`RaceListScreenTest` asserts it true when `RaceListUiState.races` is empty
and false when it holds at least one race, mirroring
`WatchHistoryScreenTest`'s coverage of `isHistoryEmpty`. The rendered
empty state itself — the catalogue's title, body and action opening the
paste screen — is unchanged.
